keisha: opening a small PR to refresh the Quickstart Minimal tutorial. scope: shrink examples, standardize auth var, one-line first deploy (docker run), and fix two redirecting links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978
omar: sounds good. for auth let's pick one canonical env var (`REDWOOD_KEY`) and include a short migration note for older examples. keep the curl to one line.
linh: please show both curl and a tiny JS async snippet. make the JS example under 8 lines. also add an expected output so folks know their run succeeded.
keisha: plan: 1) one-line curl, 2) JS async (6 lines), 3) docker run pinned tag, 4) Troubleshooting mini-checklist. will replace /getting-started/local with /deploy/local-run.
docs-bot: preview build queued: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/978 (eta ~2m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
omar: tiny nit: prefer `export` in unix examples and fenced ```bash blocks. also suggest adding a single health-check curl after docker run.
keisha: switched to `export`, used fenced blocks. docker run pinned to `redwood/quick-min:0.3.0` and added `curl http://localhost:8080/health` expected output. also added migration note: "Previously examples used REDWOOD_TOKEN; canonical var is REDWOOD_KEY. Both accepted during migration"
linh: add a 3-item Troubleshooting list for onboarding hits: 1) 401 -> check REDWOOD_KEY 2) 502 -> model mismatch / incompatible quantization 3) port conflict -> change 8080 or kill process. tiny commands for logs included.
keisha: added Troubleshooting, a tiny `docker logs` example, and a short "what to expect" section: server returns `{"message":"hello world"}` on GET /.
preview-bot: preview created: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/978 (building) :building_construction:
ci-bot: docs lint: passed; link-check: found 1 redirect -> auto-fixed in commit (sha: 5fa2b7) :white_check_mark:
omar: LGTM content-wise. small editorial: in JS snippet prefer `from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient` note if applicable to the SDK version.
keisha: added a one-line migration note in the SDK section mentioning the import rename for v8+. squashed WIP commits and updated PR description to list changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978 - requesting review from @omar @linh
